answers.core: It is an add-on available in the [asset library](https://godotengine.org/asset-library/asset/892), but several folks on [Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/godot/comments/m5cpjv/viewportspy_an_inspector_tool_that_lets_you_spy/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web2x&context=3) and [Github](https://github.com/awkwardpolygons/viewport-spy/issues/1) requested I submit this proposal so that everyone can have access to this simple feature by default.
answers.workaround: A few lines of script? No. A relatively simple plugin? Yes.

title: Add inspector UI that lets you spy on what a viewport is rendering (ViewportSpy)
